onset.Description: Onset (in seconds) of the event from the beginning of the first datapoint. Negative onsets account for events before the first stored data point.

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds from onset. Must be zero, positive, or 'n/a' if unavailable. A zero value indicates an impulse event.

sample.Description: The event onset time in number of sampling points.First sample is 0.

value.Description: Integer event ID assigned per file by the BIDS writer (MNE-BIDS) to each distinct trial_type; it is not the source stim code (see trial_type) and may differ between files.

trial_type.Description: Source stim code as 'stimcode-<N>', N = value of the source 'stim' vector (imagery_basic.zip:imagery_basic/data/fp_im_t_h.mat). Each event spans one constant segment of the stim vector (onset at the sample where the code changes; duration until the next change). The full vector is kept verbatim in the STIMCODE channel.

Levels.stimcode-11: Cue: tongue motor imagery (imagery_basic README (SDR zk881ps0522): '11: tongue movement or imagery, 12: hand movement or imagery')
Levels.stimcode-12: Cue: hand motor imagery (imagery_basic README (SDR zk881ps0522): '11: tongue movement or imagery, 12: hand movement or imagery')
